lines.en: I try not to snap the dry twigs.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我的影子细长。
lines.en: In the birch wood my shadow stretches thin.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边抬头看四周。
lines.en: I walk with my head up, scanning around.
Cherry petals cling to my spine.

lines.zh: 雪地里留下一串窄蹄印。
lines.en: A narrow line of hoofprints crosses the snow.
I skirt along the edge of the flowers.

lines.zh: 树影一晃，我就换个方向。
lines.en: A shadow shifts and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶还立着。
lines.en: The grass still stands where I have passed.

lines.zh: 风从背后吹来，我才放心。
lines.en: I relax only when the wind is at my back.

lines.zh: 我穿过灌木，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I slip through the brush as quietly as I can.
The streambank mud is soft, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，耳朵转个不停。
lines.en: I stop and start, ears swiveling.

lines.zh: 这片林子我熟得闭眼也能走。
lines.en: I could walk this wood with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 蹄尖落地的声音像雨点。
lines.en: My hooves tap the ground like raindrops.

lines.zh: 我挑着落枝少的地方走。
lines.en: I pick the paths with fewest fallen twigs.

lines.zh: 暮色里，我慢慢往林深处去。
lines.en: At dusk I drift deeper into the trees.
I stand with my neck slightly stiff.

lines.zh: 耳朵转到声音来的方向。
lines.en: My ears turn toward the sound.
I dare not lower my head to graze for long.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张一合，闻着空气。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, reading the air.

lines.zh: 那声狼嚎让我耳朵贴平。
lines.en: That howl flattens my ears.
A petal lands on the tip of my nose.
I stand rigid as a branch.
Snow settles on my back and I do not shake.

lines.zh: 我盯着同一片叶子看了很久。
lines.en: I have stared at the same leaf for a long while.
The wind has stopped; I dare not move at all.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有爪子踩过枯枝。
lines.en: I listen for paws snapping dry twigs.
The sun has shifted and my shadow lengthens.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里剩的草。
lines.en: I slowly chew what grass is left in my mouth.

lines.zh: 一只蝴蝶绕着我转了两圈。
lines.en: A butterfly circles me twice.
Do not move yet; let me look at you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，耳朵朝你竖起。
lines.en: I raise my head, ears pointed at you.
You do not smell of wolf.
Ten paces between us — that suits me.
One more step from you and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我歪着头猜你要做什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, guessing your intent.

lines.zh: 你的手一抬，我后腿就沉。
lines.en: Your hand lifts and my hind legs sink, ready.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了半圈，我先听着。
lines.en: One ear turns. I'll listen first.
I remember human bows.

lines.zh: 你呼吸放轻了，我也放松些。
lines.en: Your breathing softened, so mine eases a little.

lines.zh: 我跳开一步，又回头看你。
lines.en: I spring back a step, then look at you again.
My hind legs buckle and I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 我发出一声短促的惊叫。
lines.en: I let out a short, sharp cry.
Blood on the fallen leaves stands out.
I twist to look at the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我忘了该往哪跑。
lines.en: That blow made me forget which way to flee.
I stagger into the bushes.
My chest heaves and won't settle.
The body under my coat is shivering.
I must run — I must.
Those leaves smell rather good.
I shift half a step forward and halt.
Is that thing you are holding edible?

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，还是够不着。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and still can't reach.

lines.zh: 鼻子先过去，腿还在犹豫。
lines.en: My nose goes first; my legs still hesitate.

lines.zh: 林子里总有更甜的嫩芽。
lines.en: There are always sweeter shoots in this wood.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我才敢过来。
lines.en: Step back a little and I will come closer.
I lick my lips once.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了害怕一会儿。
lines.en: That smell made me forget fear for a moment.
I will take one bite and run — agreed?
Startled, I back away two steps.

lines.zh: 我侧身避开，还是碰到了。
lines.en: I turned aside and still grazed you.
Do not stand between me and the trees.
Startled, I hop back half a step.
Your legs are sturdier than mine.
That touch makes me want to run.
My antler grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一条小路上。
lines.en: We are squeezed onto the same little path.
I lower my head and yield to the side.

lines.zh: 再碰一下，我就进林子了。
lines.en: One more bump and I am in the trees.
I nudge your jaw with my nose.
We walk side by side through the flowers.
I trot a quick circle around you.

lines.zh: 这片灌木够藏下两只鹿。
lines.en: This thicket can hide two deer.

lines.zh: 我的角今年长得不错吧。
lines.en: My antlers grew well this year, did they not?

lines.zh: 你闻起来像春天的树皮。
lines.en: You smell of spring bark.
We lick each other's foreheads.
The wood's too bright — I slip behind a tree.

lines.zh: 林间安静，只有我们的蹄声。
lines.en: The wood is quiet but for our hooves.
By summer there will be fawns.
I take a tender leaf and chew.
I sniff a fruit on the ground.
This is not what I usually eat.
I pick it up and drop it again.

lines.zh: 嘴里的草还没咽下去呢。
lines.en: The grass in my mouth is not even swallowed.

lines.zh: 我低头捡落果，耳朵还竖着。
lines.en: I lower my head for fallen fruit, ears still up.
This one is too small to be worth it.
I sniff it three times before deciding.
I hold it in my mouth and do not rush to swallow.
The ones that fall from the tree are sweetest.

lines.zh: 我锁定的从来是逃跑的路。
lines.en: What I lock onto is always an escape route.
If you move, I am running.
I caught the glint of a bow.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我比你熟多了。
lines.en: I know this wood far better than you.
I do not fight; I only run fast.

lines.zh: 狼靠近时我也这样绷紧。
lines.en: I tense this way when wolves near too.
My hind legs are already digging in.
You have blocked my path to the left.
I am counting the distance to the bushes.

lines.zh: 你叹气的那一下，我就走了。
lines.en: That sigh of yours was my cue.
I back a step, watching your hands.
You go right, I go left — even.

lines.zh: 我绕着树转，你也跟着转。
lines.en: I circle the tree and you follow.
My ears stay fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你追不上一只受惊的鹿。
lines.en: You cannot catch a startled deer.

lines.zh: 我在找两条腿之间的空隙。
lines.en: I am looking for a gap between your legs.
One moment of distraction and I bolt.
My breathing quickens.
There is a way out past the river.

lines.zh: 你走近的每一步，我都记着。
lines.en: I note every step you take closer.
All I can do is butt you with my antlers.
Do not crowd me; I crash wildly when panicked.

lines.zh: 我前蹄抬起来，砸在你的盾上。
lines.en: My forelegs come up and hammer your shield.
That charge leaves me staggering too.
I am shoving past you, not fighting.
My antler tip scrapes your arm.
I am cornered against the roots.
Even panicked hooves can hurt.
Step back and I run at once.
I am the one hurting, and the one crying out.
I peek out from behind a birch.
Where flowers bloom, there I am.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我呼出一团白气。
lines.en: On the snowfield I breathe out a white cloud.
In the morning mist I see you first.
I step out from under the cherry trees.
The forest edge is where deer belong.

lines.zh: 我站在蕨丛间，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand among the ferns, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 这季节的嫩芽刚好长出来。
lines.en: The shoots are just coming up this season.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味送给你了。
lines.en: The wind has carried my scent to you.
I shake out my newly grown coat.

lines.zh: 皮毛烧焦的味道太近了。
lines.en: The smell of burning fur is far too close.

lines.zh: 我落地时折了一下前腿。
lines.en: My foreleg buckled when I landed.
Water closes over me and I paddle desperately.

lines.zh: 巨响把我震得耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 有东西深深扎进我的肩。
lines.en: Something has sunk deep into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 一股冷气钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: A cold force seeps into my bones.

lines.zh: 雪盖住了草，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: Snow covers the grass and hunger makes me weak.
The thunder sounds close enough to touch.
There is nothing under my hooves.
